source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, retrieved via api.frankfurter.dev (an ECB-sourced mirror)
notes: ECB publishes on TARGET working days only, so on weekends and TARGET holidays the last published rate stands. This snapshot is dated 2026-11-05 (Thursday) and was read on 2026-11-06 (Friday). The UI must show this date rather than implying a live rate, and the engine raises a warning once the age passes four calendar days.
